description: Rotate an image clockwise by 90, 180, 270 or any angle (the canvas grows to fit; new corners get `background`), and/or flip it horizontally (mirror) or vertically. Flips apply after the rotation, as seen on screen. EXIF orientation is applied first (autoOrient, default on), so with angle 0 this simply "fixes" sideways phone photos. Output JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF ("keep" = same as input), name <name>-rotated.<ext>. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/photo-filters/

angle.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees (negative = counter-clockwise). Default 90.

autoOrient.description: Apply the EXIF Orientation tag first (what browsers show). Default true.

background.description: Fill for the corners uncovered by a non-right-angle rotation. Default transparent (white in JPEG).

format.description: Output format. Default keep (JPEG/PNG/WebP stay, others become PNG).

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for JPEG / WebP / AVIF (ignored for PNG). Default 92, same as the website.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: image_rotate
title: Rotate / flip image
